title: Digest-pinned disposable environment for offline engineering admission
objective: Provision the exact engineering-only dependencies before admission without installation inside the workflow or trusting candidate-selected dependencies.
rationale: The hosted runner lacks pytest under Python isolated mode. The existing frozen checker correctly fails OFFLINE_DEPENDENCY_MISSING:pytest. Environment provisioning and new baseline admission require independent approval.
scope_in: A separately built disposable container approved by immutable GHCR digest, containing Python 3.14, pytest 9.1.1, jsonschema 4.26.0, Git and the runtime needed by pinned checkout.
Administrative image variable and full baseline SHA selected outside candidate files; reject mutable image tags and missing variables.
Offline dependency/version preflight under python -I; original Git object, hash, scope, synthetic regression and confirmed exposure checks remain intact.
Independent review of exact image build inputs, complete transitive dependency lock/hashes, image digest and source tree; trusted manifest refresh only after that review.
scope_out: No automatic package installation or image build/push in the admission job.
No persistent self-hosted runner or production credentials/data mounts.
No market, holdout, strategy, backtest, research, paper/demo or LIVE execution.
No baseline variable mutation, manifest self-approval, incident alteration or gate closure by this draft.
files_forbidden: All preserved incident, review, snapshot and historical evidence bytes
data_allowed: Engineering metadata and disposable synthetic fixtures only.
data_forbidden: Market datasets, secret values, production databases and holdout payloads.

acceptance_criteria.description: Image uses independently reviewed fully pinned inputs and transitive package hashes; isolated Python sees exact required versions.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Independent image build provenance/SBOM review; python -I preflight inside exact image digest.

acceptance_criteria.description: Missing image, mutable tag, other registry/repository and altered dependency versions fail closed.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Adversarial configuration fixtures and isolated interpreter checks without installing packages.

acceptance_criteria.description: All 20 Git admission tests and 43 guard tests pass in the approved image; current diagnostic remains the verified exposure block.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Frozen checker on exact separately approved source tree; preserve test logs and source/image hashes.

acceptance_criteria.description: Independent reviewer binds refreshed manifest, exact source SHA, image digest and protected administrative variables; altered candidate trees still fail.
acceptance_criteria.verification_method: Out-of-candidate review followed by separate administrator activation; no implementing-agent self-certification.

rollback_plan: Keep the draft unmerged and retain existing trusted baseline/image configuration until independent review succeeds. No automatic weakening of checks, deletion or operational activation.

risks.risk: Candidate source grants itself trust through a replaced manifest or environment.
risks.mitigation: Administrative immutable image digest and full source SHA; original metadata tree equality and trusted checker remain authoritative.

risks.risk: Dependency installation introduces network or uncontrolled code during admission.
risks.mitigation: Build and inspect image separately; admission only verifies preinstalled exact versions, no pip install.

notes: DRAFT is not APPROVED or CLOSED. The original manifest is unchanged in this proposal, so the candidate tree is intentionally inadmissible until a separately reviewed manifest and baseline are approved. No claim of full runtime network/process sandbox or restored holdout independence.
